THE SCENE

Your class podcast records in ten minutes. Today you will interview a guest about jobs. Your first question compares 1949 and 1971. You need four numbers, and four people each have one.

THE HISTORY

This show is about Romana Acosta Bañuelos. In 1949 she started a tortilla factory in Los Angeles. Later she started a bank for Mexican American families. From 1971 to 1974 her name was on new dollar bills.
